rachel.sales: Heads-up team — Olga from InsuraCorp asked for a short POC to validate redaction + classification in EU. Need hosting rec and acceptance criteria by Tue. Quick replies only please.

noah.se: Notes from call with Olga:
- Use case: ingest historical claims docs (pdfs) -> extract entities + redact PHI -> classify claim severity
- Success: redaction recall >= 97% and classification F1 >= 0.85 on their holdout set
- Latency: API mode for analyst UI, 95p < 350ms for 200-token responses
- Volume: 50k docs over 2 weeks, avg 120 tokens after OCR

amar.security: They require EU data residency and customer-managed keys for at-rest encryption. Also want 1-year audit log retention and proof of key access policy.

rachel.sales: So hosting options: Hosted (eu-only tenancy, faster), Dedicated (CMK + isolation), Private (on-prem/vpc, longest lead). Thoughts?

noah.se: ML constraints: to hit 350ms P95 we can use redwood-embed-small-q4 for extractors + redwood-llm-medium-q4 for summaries. Dedicated gives predictable latency; hosted might work with smaller model but CMK is a blocker.

mike.infra: Quick sizing estimate: baseline for 50k docs/2w with 10 workers = 2x A100-eq baseline, autoscale to 4x for peak ingestion windows. Dedicated provisioning ETA ~72h in eu-west. Private requires procurement + infra slots (4-10 weeks).

kevin.finance: Procurement wants a short 30-day POC with cost cap. Can we put together rough numbers for Hosted vs Dedicated including reserved vs overage? Also they asked about data egress costs for EU storage.

olga.insurance: From legal: if Dedicated required, we need CMK ownership and an audit exportable weekly. Also: minimal downtime SLA for POC. Can we get a demo topology?

noah.se: For topology we can offer: In Dedicated: isolated GPU pool in eu-west, customer KMS (key-wrap), audit logs exported to S3. Hosted: tenant in eu-region with server-side keys (not customer-managed) and limited audit retention unless upgraded. Private: full VPC, KMS in-customer. We'll draft diagrams.

amar.security: Action item: customer must provide KMS ARN + admin IAM for key policy. Also need to sign off on log retention export policy. If they require HSM-backed keys, Private is only option.

rachel.sales: Proposed acceptance criteria for POC (draft):
- Redaction recall >= 97% and precision >= 98% on labeled eval set (1000 samples)
- Classification F1 >= 0.85 on holdout (200 samples)
- End-to-end median latency < 180ms, P95 < 350ms for 200 tokens in eu-west
- Audit logs available and exportable within 24h
- Capacity: sustain ingest rate of 100 docs/min for 2h daily bursts

mike.infra: I'll prepare capacity plan + Dedicated vs Hosted perf tradeoffs. Will include model variants for fallback rules: llm-medium.fp16 -> llm-medium.q4 -> llm-small.q4.

kevin.finance: I'll model costs assuming 50k docs * 120 tokens = 6M tokens plus baseline GPU reservation. Draft numbers by EOD tomorrow.

olga.insurance: Can you also include a simple rollback/escape clause in SOW and a contact for security escalation? Procurement insists.

rachel.sales: Yes — Ben from legal can add SOW fallback. Ben out today but will follow. For the POC decision: if CMK is mandatory, preferred path is Dedicated; if they can accept provider keys, Hosted is faster. Private only if they insist on on-prem or HSM.

amar.security: One more: ensure data-at-rest encryption in backups and ability to delete test datasets upon POC end. We'll require delete API call and a signed attestation.

noah.se: Example test call we'll use in harness:
```
POST /v1/pipeline/run
{
  "model_extract": "redwood-embed-small-q4",
  "model_llm": "redwood-llm-medium-q4",
  "task": "redact_and_classify",
  "input": "<OCR_TEXT>",
  "max_tokens": 200
}
```
Load will run 10 workers for baseline, spike to 40 for bursts.

rachel.sales: Actions: Noah prepare eval harness + 1k labeled redaction set (owner: noah.se). Mike prepare Dedicated sizing + provisioning ETA (owner: mike.infra). Amar confirm CMK steps & deletion attestation flow (owner: amar.security). Kevin draft cost with cap (owner: kevin.finance). Olga to confirm KMS ARN and legal asks (owner: olga.insurance).

mike.infra: 705 will deliver plan by EOD tomorrow.

noah.se: 705 will start eval set.

amar.security: 705 will validate deletion attestation template and CMK flow.

kevin.finance: 705 drafting budget scenarios.

olga.insurance: 705 getting KMS ARN and legal point.

deploy-bot: Link to presales checklist: https://redwood.internal/presales/checklists/eu-poc-template

rachel.sales: Thanks team. We'll present the Dedicated-first option with fallback to Hosted for speed if CMK can be negotiated. If any showstoppers appear, flag here immediately.
